plans.selectionRule: Use when no trusted remote compute node is live-proven or when explicitly selected by the operator.
requiredObservations: local CPU, logical-core, RAM, disk, and network inventory
compatible Bun, Ollama, and Hermes installations
local model files with exact size and SHA-256 evidence

plans.selectionRule: Use only after the compute node is returned by the Orange compute fabric with a trusted SSH CIM hardware probe.
requiredObservations: trusted remote host identity and user profile
remote CPU, logical-core, RAM, disk, and network inventory from ssh-cim-live
remote Ollama, Hermes, and model inventory without adopting remote evidence as local evidence
resolved external compute state and model-store paths
plans.fallback: Rerun planning with --topology single-computer; never translate a failed two-computer probe into two-computer readiness.
